description:
Native agent CLIs manager with Ghostty terminals, an embedded browser, and an IDE.

Ghostex is an all-in-one native agents workspace: agent chats, a code editor, and a browser for every agent CLI and subscription you have, in one fast native window built with Rust and GPUI.

Features:
- A real chat for every agent — thinking, tool calls, and file edits fold into tidy cards, diffs are readable, images are clickable, and prompts queue while the agent works. It is still the agent's own CLI underneath, and the raw terminal is one hotkey away.
- Coordinators that run the work — tell a coordinator what needs doing and it hands each piece to a thread it starts, briefs, and keeps track of, in its own Git worktree when threads should run in parallel.
- Multiple Claude and Codex accounts with automatic failover when limits are hit.
- Remote access to your machines via phone pairing or Tailscale.
- Optional plugins for Linear, Jira, GitHub, Sentry, and more.
macOS: Apple Silicon DMG · Windows: x64 installer · x64 portable · ARM64 installer · ARM64 portable
Linux x64: .deb · .rpm · tarball (mise/ubi) · AUR (ghostex-bin)
Android: APK · iOS: TestFlight through Discord (post in the iOS channel)
10.25.1 - 2026-10-17
Ghostex 10.25.1 is out. Agents start without stopping at a "Do you trust this folder?" prompt, the chat status line stays on one row, and the phone's Catch me up moves into the ⋯ menu.
🤖 Agents
- Agents no longer stop at a "Do you trust this folder?" prompt: before Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, Copilot, Gemini, Grok Build, Antigravity, Pi or Factory Droid starts, Ghostex marks its project or worktree folder as trusted, and it never trusts your home folder or anything above it. Turn it off in Settings > Agents > Trust project folders automatically.
💬 Chat
- The status line stays on one row and scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, on the computer and the phone; on the computer a vertical mouse wheel over it scrolls it too.
📱 On the phone
- Catch me up moves into the ⋯ menu above Side chat, and the chat box no longer shrinks while you scroll.
- Move left and Move right in a machine tab's long-press menu reorder the machine strip.
